Fold background shader source by Yohei Nishitsuji.
Original post (18 January 2025): https://x.com/YoheiNishitsuji/status/1880561598982668452
The author's profile states: "My code shared @x is MIT Licensed" (observed 2026-10-18).
The complete published expression, with its social-media hashtag omitted, is:

float i,e,R,s;vec3 q,p,d=vec3(-FC.yx/r.y*.8*(abs(cos(t*.3)*.3+.1+.8)),1);for(q--;i++<119.;i>89.?d/=-d:d){e+=i/5e3;o+=e*e/25.;s=1.;p=q+=d*e*R*.16;p=vec3(log2(R=length(p))-2.-t*.3,-p.z/R,atan(p.x,p.y));for(e=--p.y;s<1e5;s+=s)e+=cos(dot(cos(p.zyy*s),cos(p.xyx*s)))/s;}

fold.mjs initializes shader variables and the output, guards only the singular
radius, and grades the accumulated grayscale light in teal/copper/chrome.
The 119 outer steps, 17 inner frequency doublings, uncentered FC direction,
and post-iteration d/=-d rule are preserved.
